ModMetaData.name: Collection Presets [Star Sky Mods]
ModMetaData.author: chupakobra6 | Star Sky Mods
ModMetaData.description: Apply recommended mod settings from one in-game window. Choose individual presets or apply all available presets; enabling Collection Presets does not change your settings automatically. FEATURES • Find presets supplied by your active mods in one place. • Includes a ×2 mass and bulk preset for Enhanced Carrying Capacity; bulk applies with Combat Extended. • Change only the fields listed in each preset, preserving unrelated settings. • Undo the last application, with protection against overwriting later manual changes. HOW TO USE From the main menu, open Mod Settings and select Collection Presets. Tick the presets you want, then click “Apply selected presets”. Use “Select all available” to choose the available set, or “Undo last application” to revert the previous application. COMPATIBILITY RimWorld 1.6. The target mod must be active for its preset to be available. Apply and undo presets from the main menu, with no colony loaded. Restart the game after applying settings if a target mod caches them. FEEDBACK Found a bug or an inaccuracy? Leave a comment on the mod page or on Boosty. Preview artwork: Star Sky Mods.
